scientific_question: Do the published Feynman-i-epsilon Toller projector and kernel cancellation remain numerically realized beyond the old j=1/2 special case on the source-faithful gamma-simple j=2,5 channels already used in Iter439-440?

source.paper: Bianchi, Chen, Gamonal, Toller matrices and the Feynman i-epsilon in spinfoams, arXiv:2604.24945v1 (2026)
source.feynman_poles: rhotilde=rho+i*epsilon for plus and rhotilde=rho-i*epsilon for minus
source.important_guard: epsilon acts in spectral rhotilde, never as beta+i*epsilon

required_checks: all Feynman poles remain separated from all Toller poles on the frozen source matrix
P_jj(rhotilde;rho)*t_plus/minus(rhotilde) has a finite Cauchy-stable boundary value at every published Toller-pole location on the frozen delta grid
scope_guard: A pass is a source-level spectral projector/pole-cancellation realization on the frozen j=2,5 gamma-simple matrix. It is not a proof of the full K5 Haar/angular causal vertex, cutoff removal, family terminality, D7-S3/S4 closure, terminal D7 authorization, or Candidate Gravity activation.
